experiment.title: Full provider/model pool: Incumbent versus VultrInspired tournament population
experiment.purpose: Compare repository-owned Incumbent and VultrInspired catalogue variants over the complete reconciled provider/model candidate population, preserving source evidence classes and separating candidate enumeration from runtime admission.
experiment.hypothesis: VultrInspired improves loss-aware metadata, modality/capability representation, provenance and diagnostics across the full provider/model pool without losing source identity or overstating candidate readiness.
controlled_variables: Identical incumbent v5 input document and byte-identical model rows for paired catalogue trials
Identical provider identifiers, model identifiers and observation timestamps
Identical fixture-set revision and expected semantic facts
Pinned incumbent source and VultrInspired implementation revisions
Offline deterministic execution; provider credentials absent; network and inference disabled; runtime activation deferred
Identical source-hash-bound full-pool population manifest for both catalogue variants
Keep the 7,341 historical Actions census separate from the 9,588 enumerated g4f universe
Preserve source-scoped provider identity and exact model identifiers; apply only reviewed aliases
Seed every candidate before applying task-specific runtime admission and provider eligibility
acceptance_criteria: Incumbent v5 output remains the baseline and retains its existing provider/access/quota semantics.
VultrInspired is a repository-native adapter with its own versioned output schema and standard-library-only execution.
Paired fixtures retain provider/model identity, context/output limits, pricing classifications and access evidence.
Decimal strings and integer prices remain exact; binary floats are explicitly diagnosed as precision-limited input.
Input/output modalities, capability descriptors and unknown source fields remain observable when supplied.
Malformed individual records are isolated with indexed diagnostics while valid siblings remain available.
Unknown catalog-active state, entitlement, quota and inference state remain unknown unless source evidence supplies a value.
Execution is offline and produces zero provider requests, credential reads and inference calls.

The population compiler reconciles 172 quota/service records/118 distinct service provider keys, 91 model-lane records/89 distinct providers, the 60-provider g4f working catalog and the 160-provider/9,588-pair g4f universe without collapsing evidence classes.
The g4f universe preserves 5,347 upstream-only pairs, 1,156 fork-only pairs and 3,085 overlapping pairs as the 9,588-pair enumeration.
The 7,341 endpoint figure remains a historical Actions-based verified floor dated 2026-11-01 and is never summed with the 9,588 enumerated candidate pairs.
All enumerated candidate pairs are represented in the tournament seed population with source provenance; runtime eligibility and inference admission remain closed until separately evidenced.
Incumbent and VultrInspired full-pool variants consume byte-identical population input and emit a digest-bound paired manifest.
Provider aliases remain source-scoped unless an explicit reviewed mapping authorizes a join.

execution_policy.hash_contract: Repository source pins use Git blob SHA-1; each generated population manifest computes SHA-256 over exact source bytes.
